Inside

Somebody here sweats the details.

It's a small crew behind that counter, and you can tell.

A Google Local Guide put it better than we could: you can tell the owner takes pride in keeping the convenience store and the fuel stations clean and up to date. That's the whole thing, really — a highway stop where the floors are clean, the case is full, and the fry trays get changed instead of sitting.

The building wears the theme on the outside: checkered flags on the oval sign, a black-and-white band running under the roofline, race cars along the wall over the hot case. Out front, WA-410 keeps going east toward Crystal Mountain and Rainier, which is why the doors are unlocked before most people's alarms go off.
